fact.en:
What are the simplest organic compounds made of?

Only two elements: carbon and hydrogen! These compounds are called hydrocarbons, and every hydrocarbon has a carbon backbone with hydrogen atoms attached to it.
fact.tl:
Saan gawa ang pinakasimpleng organic compounds?

Sa dalawang elemento lang: carbon at hydrogen! Ang mga compound na ito ay tinatawag na hydrocarbons, at bawat hydrocarbon ay may carbon backbone na may nakakabit na hydrogen atoms.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang gihimo sa pinakasimple nga organic compounds?

Sa duha lang ka elemento: carbon ug hydrogen! Kini nga mga compound gitawag ug hydrocarbons, ug ang matag hydrocarbon adunay carbon backbone nga may nakakabit nga hydrogen atoms.

cards.illustration: A simple chain of black carbon balls with smaller white hydrogen balls attached, shown as a 3D model.

fact.en: A molecular formula simply counts how many atoms of each element are in a molecule, like CH4 for methane.
fact.tl: Ang molecular formula ay binibilang lang kung ilang atoms ng bawat elemento ang nasa isang molecule, tulad ng CH4 para sa methane.
fact.bis: Ang molecular formula nag-ihap lang kung pila ka atoms sa matag elemento ang naa sa usa ka molecule, sama sa CH4 para sa methane.

cards.illustration: A methane molecule model with one black carbon ball and four white hydrogen balls, with the label CH4 beside it.

fact.en: A condensed structural formula writes connected atoms as a group, like CH3CH3 for ethane, so you can see how the atoms are linked.
fact.tl: Ang condensed structural formula ay isinusulat ang magkakadikit na atoms bilang isang grupo, tulad ng CH3CH3 para sa ethane, para makita kung paano sila nakakabit.
fact.bis: Ang condensed structural formula gisulat ang magkadikit nga atoms isip usa ka grupo, sama sa CH3CH3 para sa ethane, aron makita kung giunsa sila pagkakabit.

cards.illustration: Two carbon balls joined together, each with three small hydrogen balls attached, showing the grouping of atoms.

fact.en:
Why are some hydrocarbons called saturated?

Because their carbon atoms are full of hydrogen! They have only single bonds between carbon atoms, so no more hydrogen can be added.
fact.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na saturated ang ilang hydrocarbons?

Dahil puno ng hydrogen ang kanilang carbon atoms! Mayroon lang silang single bonds sa pagitan ng carbon atoms, kaya wala nang hydrogen na maidadagdag.
fact.bis:
Ngano gitawag ug saturated ang uban nga hydrocarbons?

Tungod kay puno sa hydrogen ang ilang carbon atoms! Aduna lang silay single bonds tali sa carbon atoms, busa wala nay hydrogen nga madugang.

cards.illustration: A chain of carbon balls connected by single sticks, each carbon surrounded by hydrogen balls, looking full and crowded.

fact.en:
What makes a hydrocarbon unsaturated?

It has double or triple bonds between carbon atoms! These extra bonds mean the carbon is not holding as many hydrogen atoms as it could.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nagpapagawang unsaturated sa isang hydrocarbon?

Mayroon itong double o triple bonds sa pagitan ng carbon atoms! Ang mga dagdag na bond na ito ay nangangahulugang hindi hawak ng carbon ang lahat ng hydrogen atoms na kaya nito.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang nakapahimo sa usa ka hydrocarbon nga unsaturated?

Aduna kini double o triple bonds tali sa carbon atoms! Kining mga dugang nga bond nagpasabot nga ang carbon wala magkupot sa tanang hydrogen atoms nga kaya niya.

cards.illustration: Two carbon balls connected by two parallel sticks, showing a double bond, with fewer hydrogen balls around them.

fact.en: Alkanes are the simplest hydrocarbons, with only single bonds between carbon atoms, and they are also called paraffins.
fact.tl: Ang alkanes ay ang pinakasimpleng hydrocarbons, na may single bonds lamang sa pagitan ng carbon atoms, at tinatawag din silang paraffins.
fact.bis: Ang alkanes mao ang pinakasimple nga hydrocarbons, nga adunay single bonds lamang tali sa carbon atoms, ug gitawag usab sila ug paraffins.

cards.illustration: A straight chain of four carbon balls connected by single sticks, with hydrogen balls filling all remaining spots.

fact.en: Alkenes are hydrocarbons with one or more double bonds between carbon atoms, and they are also known as olefins.
fact.tl: Ang alkenes ay mga hydrocarbons na may isa o higit pang double bonds sa pagitan ng carbon atoms, at kilala rin sila bilang olefins.
fact.bis: Ang alkenes mao ang mga hydrocarbons nga adunay usa o daghan pang double bonds tali sa carbon atoms, ug nailhan usab sila nga olefins.

cards.illustration: A chain of carbon balls where two in the middle are connected by two parallel sticks, showing a double bond.

fact.en: Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with at least one triple bond between carbon atoms, and they are also called acetylenes.
fact.tl: Ang alkynes ay mga unsaturated hydrocarbons na may hindi bababa sa isang triple bond sa pagitan ng carbon atoms, at tinatawag din silang acetylenes.
fact.bis: Ang alkynes mao ang mga unsaturated hydrocarbons nga adunay labing menos usa ka triple bond tali sa carbon atoms, ug gitawag usab sila ug acetylenes.

cards.illustration: Two carbon balls connected by three parallel sticks, showing a triple bond, with only one hydrogen ball on each carbon.

fact.en:
Which gas in your kitchen stove is the simplest alkane?

Methane! It has the formula CH4 and is a major part of LPG, the fuel used for cooking.
fact.tl:
Anong gas sa iyong kalan ang pinakasimpleng alkane?

Methane! Ito ay may formula na CH4 at pangunahing bahagi ng LPG, ang gas na ginagamit sa pagluluto.
fact.bis:
Unsa nga gas sa imong kalan ang pinakasimple nga alkane?

Methane! Kini adunay formula nga CH4 ug pangunang bahin sa LPG, ang gas nga gigamit sa pagluto.

cards.illustration: A blue flame burning on a gas stove burner, with a small methane molecule model floating nearby.

fact.en:
How do fruits like bananas ripen even after they are picked?

They release ethene, an alkene gas! Ethene acts as a natural ripening agent that softens and sweetens the fruit.
fact.tl:
Paano nahihinog ang mga prutas tulad ng saging kahit napitas na?

Naglalabas sila ng ethene, isang alkene gas! Ang ethene ay natural na ripening agent na nagpapalambot at nagpapatamis sa prutas.
fact.bis:
Giunsa pagkahinog ang mga prutas sama sa saging bisan human kini mapupo?

Nagpagawas sila ug ethene, usa ka alkene gas! Ang ethene usa ka natural nga ripening agent nga nagpahumok ug nagpatam-is sa prutas.

cards.illustration: A bunch of yellow bananas with a few green ones, with small invisible gas particles shown as tiny dots rising from the fruit.

fact.en: Ethyne, also called acetylene, is the simplest alkyne and is used as a fuel for welding because it burns very hot.
fact.tl: Ang ethyne, na tinatawag ding acetylene, ay ang pinakasimpleng alkyne at ginagamit bilang panggatong sa welding dahil napakainit nito kung magliyab.
fact.bis: Ang ethyne, nga gitawag usab ug acetylene, mao ang pinakasimple nga alkyne ug gigamit isip sugnod sa welding tungod kay init kaayo kini kon mosiga.

cards.illustration: A welding torch with a bright blue flame cutting through a metal bar, with a small ethyne molecule model beside it.

fact.en:
Why do different organic compounds smell and react so differently?

Because of functional groups! A functional group is a special cluster of atoms that gives a compound its specific properties and reactions.
fact.tl:
Bakit magkakaiba ang amoy at reaksyon ng iba't ibang organic compounds?

Dahil sa functional groups! Ang functional group ay espesyal na kumpol ng atoms na nagbibigay sa compound ng tiyak na katangian at reaksyon.
fact.bis:
Ngano lainlain man ang baho ug reaksyon sa lainlaing organic compounds?

Tungod sa functional groups! Ang functional group usa ka espesyal nga tapok sa atoms nga naghatag sa compound sa piho nga mga kinaiya ug reaksyon.

cards.illustration: A large organic molecule with one part highlighted by a glowing circle, showing the special functional group attached.

fact.en: Alcohols are organic compounds that contain a hydroxyl group, which is an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom, and they are used as disinfectants and solvents.
fact.tl: Ang alcohols ay mga organic compounds na naglalaman ng hydroxyl group, na isang oxygen atom na nakakabit sa hydrogen atom, at ginagamit ang mga ito bilang disinfectants at solvents.
fact.bis: Ang alcohols mao ang mga organic compounds nga adunay hydroxyl group, nga usa ka oxygen atom nga nakakabit sa hydrogen atom, ug gigamit kini isip disinfectants ug solvents.

cards.illustration: A bottle of rubbing alcohol with a molecular model showing an oxygen and hydrogen pair attached to a carbon chain.

fact.en: Isopropyl alcohol is a common alcohol used as a disinfectant to clean skin and surfaces, especially important during the COVID-19 pandemic.
fact.tl: Ang isopropyl alcohol ay karaniwang alcohol na ginagamit bilang disinfectant sa paglilinis ng balat at mga gamit, lalo na noong panahon ng COVID-19 pandemic.
fact.bis: Ang isopropyl alcohol usa ka kasagarang alcohol nga gigamit isip disinfectant sa paglimpyo sa panit ug mga butang, ilabi na sa panahon sa COVID-19 pandemic.

cards.illustration: A hand being sprayed with rubbing alcohol from a small bottle, with a molecular model of isopropyl alcohol nearby.

fact.en: Ketones are carbonyl-containing compounds, meaning they have a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom, and acetone is a common example used in nail polish remover.
fact.tl: Ang ketones ay mga carbonyl-containing compounds, ibig sabihin may carbon atom sila na naka-double bond sa oxygen atom, at ang acetone ay karaniwang halimbawa na ginagamit sa nail polish remover.
fact.bis: Ang ketones mao ang mga carbonyl-containing compounds, nagpasabot nga adunay carbon atom nga naka-double bond sa oxygen atom, ug ang acetone usa ka kasagarang pananglitan nga gigamit sa nail polish remover.

cards.illustration: A small bottle of nail polish remover with a molecular model showing a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom.

fact.en:
Why does nail polish remover smell so strong?

It contains acetone, a ketone! Acetone is a carbonyl compound that dissolves the polish quickly, and its strong smell comes from its small, fast-evaporating molecules.
fact.tl:
Bakit napakatapang ng amoy ng nail polish remover?

Naglalaman ito ng acetone, isang ketone! Ang acetone ay carbonyl compound na mabilis na tumutunaw ng polish, at ang matapang na amoy nito ay mula sa maliliit at mabilis mag-evaporate na molecules.
fact.bis:
Ngano kusog kaayo ang baho sa nail polish remover?

Aduna kini acetone, usa ka ketone! Ang acetone usa ka carbonyl compound nga dali nga motunaw sa polish, ug ang kusog nga baho naggikan sa gagmay ug dali nga mo-evaporate nga molecules.

cards.illustration: An open bottle of nail polish remover with wavy lines rising from it to show the strong smell evaporating.

fact.en: Aldehydes are carbonyl-containing compounds with the suffix -al, and formaldehyde is a common aldehyde used as a disinfectant and preservative in hospitals and morgues.
fact.tl: Ang aldehydes ay mga carbonyl-containing compounds na may suffix na -al, at ang formaldehyde ay karaniwang aldehyde na ginagamit bilang disinfectant at preservative sa mga ospital at morgue.
fact.bis: Ang aldehydes mao ang mga carbonyl-containing compounds nga adunay suffix nga -al, ug ang formaldehyde usa ka kasagarang aldehyde nga gigamit isip disinfectant ug preservative sa mga ospital ug morgue.

cards.illustration: A laboratory specimen jar with a clear liquid inside, with a molecular model of formaldehyde beside it.

fact.en:
What is formalin used for in hospitals?

It is a solution of formaldehyde, an aldehyde! Formalin preserves tissues and kills germs, so it is used as a disinfectant and preservative.
fact.tl:
Para saan ginagamit ang formalin sa mga ospital?

Ito ay solusyon ng formaldehyde, isang aldehyde! Ang formalin ay nagpepreserba ng mga tissue at pumapatay ng mikrobyo, kaya ginagamit ito bilang disinfectant at preservative.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang gamit sa formalin sa mga ospital?

Kini usa ka solusyon sa formaldehyde, usa ka aldehyde! Ang formalin nagpreserba sa mga tissue ug mopatay sa mga kagaw, busa gigamit kini isip disinfectant ug preservative.

cards.illustration: A clear bottle labeled formalin with a preserved biological specimen inside, showing its use in a laboratory.

fact.en: Ethers have an oxygen atom connected to two alkyl groups, and diethyl ether is used as a solvent and was once used as an anesthetic.
fact.tl: Ang ethers ay may oxygen atom na nakakabit sa dalawang alkyl groups, at ang diethyl ether ay ginagamit bilang solvent at dating ginamit bilang anesthetic.
fact.bis: Ang ethers adunay oxygen atom nga nakakabit sa duha ka alkyl groups, ug ang diethyl ether gigamit isip solvent ug kaniadto gigamit isip anesthetic.

cards.illustration: A molecular model showing an oxygen atom in the middle with two carbon chains attached on either side.

fact.en:
Why do many candies and perfumes smell fruity?

They contain esters! Esters are organic compounds with a carboxyl group, and they are used to create artificial flavorings and fragrances.
fact.tl:
Bakit parang prutas ang amoy ng maraming kendi at pabango?

Naglalaman ang mga ito ng esters! Ang esters ay mga organic compounds na may carboxyl group, at ginagamit ang mga ito sa paggawa ng artificial flavorings at fragrances.
fact.bis:
Ngano murag prutas ang baho sa daghang kendi ug pahumot?

Aduna kini mga esters! Ang esters mao ang mga organic compounds nga adunay carboxyl group, ug gigamit kini sa paghimo ug artificial flavorings ug fragrances.

cards.illustration: A bowl of colorful candies with a molecular model of an ester nearby, with wavy lines suggesting a sweet fruity smell.

fact.en: Carboxylic acids contain a carboxyl group and have the suffix -oic acid, with acetic acid being the main component of vinegar.
fact.tl: Ang carboxylic acids ay naglalaman ng carboxyl group at may suffix na -oic acid, at ang acetic acid ang pangunahing sangkap ng suka.
fact.bis: Ang carboxylic acids adunay carboxyl group ug adunay suffix nga -oic acid, ug ang acetic acid mao ang pangunang sangkap sa suka.

cards.illustration: A bottle of vinegar with a molecular model of acetic acid beside it, showing the carboxyl group highlighted.

fact.en:
What makes vinegar taste sour?

Acetic acid! It is a carboxylic acid with a carboxyl group, and it gives vinegar its sharp, sour taste.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nagpapaasim sa suka?

Acetic acid! Ito ay isang carboxylic acid na may carboxyl group, at ito ang nagbibigay sa suka ng matapang at maasim na lasa.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang nagpaaslom sa suka?

Acetic acid! Kini usa ka carboxylic acid nga adunay carboxyl group, ug kini ang naghatag sa suka sa iyang kusog ug aslom nga lami.

cards.illustration: A bottle of vinegar being poured onto a salad, with a molecular model of acetic acid floating beside it.

fact.en: Amines are organic compounds with an amine group, and compounds like epinephrine and histamine act as neurotransmitters and help relieve allergic reactions.
fact.tl: Ang amines ay mga organic compounds na may amine group, at ang mga compound tulad ng epinephrine at histamine ay nagsisilbing neurotransmitters at tumutulong sa pag-alis ng allergic reactions.
fact.bis: Ang amines mao ang mga organic compounds nga adunay amine group, ug ang mga compound sama sa epinephrine ug histamine nagsilbi nga neurotransmitters ug makatabang sa paghupay sa allergic reactions.

cards.illustration: A molecular model of an amine with a nitrogen atom highlighted, with small lightning bolts suggesting nerve signals.

fact.en: Amides are formed from the reaction of a carboxylic acid and an amine, and penicillin is a well-known amide used as an antibiotic.
fact.tl: Ang amides ay nabubuo mula sa reaksyon ng isang carboxylic acid at isang amine, at ang penicillin ay kilalang amide na ginagamit bilang antibiotic.
fact.bis: Ang amides maporma gikan sa reaksyon sa usa ka carboxylic acid ug usa ka amine, ug ang penicillin usa ka ilado nga amide nga gigamit isip antibiotic.

cards.illustration: A capsule of penicillin with a molecular model of an amide beside it, showing the connection between acid and amine parts.

fact.en:
Which alkyne boils at the highest temperature: ethyne, propyne, or hexyne?

Hexyne! Longer carbon chains have higher boiling points because the molecules stick together more strongly.
fact.tl:
Aling alkyne ang may pinakamataas na boiling point: ethyne, propyne, o hexyne?

Hexyne! Ang mas mahabang carbon chains ay may mas mataas na boiling points dahil mas malakas ang pagkakadikit ng mga molecules.
fact.bis:
Asa nga alkyne ang adunay pinakataas nga boiling point: ethyne, propyne, o hexyne?

Hexyne! Ang mas taas nga carbon chains adunay mas taas nga boiling points tungod kay mas kusog ang pagkadikit sa mga molecules.

cards.illustration: Three test tubes with different alkyne molecules, the longest chain shown with the most heat waves rising from it.

fact.en: A carbon atom has four valence electrons in its outer shell, which is why it can form four bonds with other atoms.
fact.tl: Ang carbon atom ay may apat na valence electrons sa outer shell nito, kaya nakakabuo ito ng apat na bonds sa ibang atoms.
fact.bis: Ang carbon atom adunay upat ka valence electrons sa iyang outer shell, mao nga makaporma kini ug upat ka bonds sa laing atoms.

cards.illustration: A carbon atom with four electrons shown as dots in its outer ring, with four sticks reaching out to connect to other atoms.

fact.en:
Is viscosity the ability of a compound to turn into gas?

No! Viscosity is how thick or sticky a liquid is, like how honey flows more slowly than water.
fact.tl:
Ang viscosity ba ay kakayahan ng compound na maging gas?

Hindi! Ang viscosity ay kung gaano kalapot o kalagkit ang isang likido, tulad ng pulot na mas mabagal dumaloy kaysa tubig.
fact.bis:
Ang viscosity ba mao ang abilidad sa compound nga mahimong gas?

Dili! Ang viscosity mao kung unsa ka lapot o ka pilit ang usa ka likido, sama sa dugos nga mas hinay modagayday kaysa tubig.

cards.illustration: A jar of honey being poured slowly next to a glass of water being poured quickly, showing the difference in flow.

fact.en: Some compounds contain carbon but are still considered inorganic, such as carbon dioxide and carbonates, because they lack the carbon-hydrogen bonds of organic compounds.
fact.tl: Ang ilang compounds ay naglalaman ng carbon ngunit itinuturing pa ring inorganic, tulad ng carbon dioxide at carbonates, dahil wala silang carbon-hydrogen bonds ng mga organic compounds.
fact.bis: Ang uban nga compounds adunay carbon apan giisip gihapon nga inorganic, sama sa carbon dioxide ug carbonates, tungod kay wala silay carbon-hydrogen bonds sa mga organic compounds.

cards.illustration: A molecule of carbon dioxide with one carbon and two oxygen atoms, shown next to a simple organic molecule for comparison.

fact.en: Ethane is an alkane with only two carbon atoms, and its molecular formula is C2H6.
fact.tl: Ang ethane ay isang alkane na may dalawang carbon atoms lamang, at ang molecular formula nito ay C2H6.
fact.bis: Ang ethane usa ka alkane nga adunay duha lamang ka carbon atoms, ug ang molecular formula niini mao ang C2H6.

cards.illustration: Two black carbon balls connected by a single stick, each with three white hydrogen balls attached.

fact.en: Propene is an alkene with three carbon atoms and one double bond, making it an unsaturated hydrocarbon.
fact.tl: Ang propene ay isang alkene na may tatlong carbon atoms at isang double bond, kaya ito ay unsaturated hydrocarbon.
fact.bis: Ang propene usa ka alkene nga adunay tulo ka carbon atoms ug usa ka double bond, busa kini usa ka unsaturated hydrocarbon.

cards.illustration: Three carbon balls in a chain, with two of them connected by two parallel sticks showing a double bond.

fact.en: Methyl alcohol, also called methanol, is the simplest alcohol with one carbon atom and is used as a solvent and fuel.
fact.tl: Ang methyl alcohol, na tinatawag ding methanol, ay ang pinakasimpleng alcohol na may isang carbon atom at ginagamit bilang solvent at panggatong.
fact.bis: Ang methyl alcohol, nga gitawag usab ug methanol, mao ang pinakasimple nga alcohol nga adunay usa ka carbon atom ug gigamit isip solvent ug sugnod.

cards.illustration: A small bottle of methyl alcohol with a molecular model showing one carbon atom with a hydroxyl group attached.

fact.en: Ethyl alcohol, or ethanol, is an alcohol with two carbon atoms and is found in alcoholic drinks and used as a disinfectant.
fact.tl: Ang ethyl alcohol, o ethanol, ay isang alcohol na may dalawang carbon atoms at matatagpuan sa mga inuming may alkohol at ginagamit bilang disinfectant.
fact.bis: Ang ethyl alcohol, o ethanol, usa ka alcohol nga adunay duha ka carbon atoms ug makita sa mga ilimnon nga may alkohol ug gigamit isip disinfectant.

cards.illustration: A bottle of ethyl alcohol next to a molecular model with two carbon atoms and a hydroxyl group.

fact.en: Butanone is a ketone used in perfumes and paints, and like other ketones it contains a carbonyl group with a carbon double-bonded to oxygen.
fact.tl: Ang butanone ay isang ketone na ginagamit sa mga pabango at pintura, at tulad ng ibang ketones, naglalaman ito ng carbonyl group na may carbon na naka-double bond sa oxygen.
fact.bis: Ang butanone usa ka ketone nga gigamit sa mga pahumot ug pintura, ug sama sa uban nga ketones, aduna kini carbonyl group nga may carbon nga naka-double bond sa oxygen.

cards.illustration: A paint can and a perfume bottle with a molecular model of butanone showing the carbonyl group.

fact.en: Diethyl ether is an ether with an oxygen atom between two ethyl groups, and it is used as a solvent and aerosol spray propellant.
fact.tl: Ang diethyl ether ay isang ether na may oxygen atom sa pagitan ng dalawang ethyl groups, at ginagamit ito bilang solvent at aerosol spray propellant.
fact.bis: Ang diethyl ether usa ka ether nga adunay oxygen atom tali sa duha ka ethyl groups, ug gigamit kini isip solvent ug aerosol spray propellant.

cards.illustration: A spray can releasing a fine mist, with a molecular model of diethyl ether showing the central oxygen atom.

fact.en: Ethyl methanoate is an ester with the suffix -oate, and it is used to create artificial flavorings and fragrances.
fact.tl: Ang ethyl methanoate ay isang ester na may suffix na -oate, at ginagamit ito sa paggawa ng artificial flavorings at fragrances.
fact.bis: Ang ethyl methanoate usa ka ester nga adunay suffix nga -oate, ug gigamit kini sa paghimo ug artificial flavorings ug fragrances.

cards.illustration: A small bottle of flavoring with a molecular model of an ester, showing the carboxyl group with the -oate structure.

fact.en: Methyl butanoate is an ester that smells like pineapple and is used in artificial fruit flavorings.
fact.tl: Ang methyl butanoate ay isang ester na amoy pinya at ginagamit sa mga artificial fruit flavorings.
fact.bis: Ang methyl butanoate usa ka ester nga baho sama sa pinya ug gigamit sa mga artificial fruit flavorings.

cards.illustration: A fresh pineapple with a molecular model of methyl butanoate beside it, with wavy lines suggesting the fruity smell.

fact.en: Octanoic acid is a carboxylic acid found in coconut oil, and it is used in making hand wash soaps.
fact.tl: Ang octanoic acid ay isang carboxylic acid na matatagpuan sa langis ng niyog, at ginagamit ito sa paggawa ng mga hand wash soap.
fact.bis: Ang octanoic acid usa ka carboxylic acid nga makita sa lana sa lubi, ug gigamit kini sa paghimo ug mga hand wash soap.

cards.illustration: A bottle of hand wash soap next to a coconut, with a molecular model of octanoic acid.

fact.en: Dodecanoic acid is a carboxylic acid also found in coconut oil and is used in making soaps and hand wash products.
fact.tl: Ang dodecanoic acid ay isang carboxylic acid na matatagpuan din sa langis ng niyog at ginagamit sa paggawa ng mga sabon at hand wash products.
fact.bis: Ang dodecanoic acid usa ka carboxylic acid nga makita usab sa lana sa lubi ug gigamit sa paghimo ug mga sabon ug hand wash products.

cards.illustration: A bar of soap and a coconut with a molecular model of dodecanoic acid, showing its long carbon chain.

fact.en: Epinephrine is an amine that acts as a neurotransmitter and is used to relieve severe allergic reactions.
fact.tl: Ang epinephrine ay isang amine na nagsisilbing neurotransmitter at ginagamit upang mapawi ang matinding allergic reactions.
fact.bis: Ang epinephrine usa ka amine nga nagsilbi nga neurotransmitter ug gigamit sa paghupay sa grabe nga allergic reactions.

cards.illustration: An epinephrine auto-injector pen with a molecular model of the amine compound beside it.

fact.en: Histamine is an amine that acts as a neurotransmitter in the body and is involved in allergic reactions.
fact.tl: Ang histamine ay isang amine na nagsisilbing neurotransmitter sa katawan at kasangkot sa mga allergic reactions.
fact.bis: Ang histamine usa ka amine nga nagsilbi nga neurotransmitter sa lawas ug nalambigit sa mga allergic reactions.

cards.illustration: A molecular model of histamine with small lightning bolts suggesting nerve signals in the body.

fact.en: Penicillin is an amide antibiotic formed from a carboxylic acid and an amine, and it is used to fight bacterial infections.
fact.tl: Ang penicillin ay isang amide antibiotic na nabuo mula sa carboxylic acid at amine, at ginagamit ito upang labanan ang mga bacterial infections.
fact.bis: Ang penicillin usa ka amide antibiotic nga naporma gikan sa carboxylic acid ug amine, ug gigamit kini sa pagpakigbatok sa mga bacterial infections.

cards.illustration: A capsule of penicillin with a molecular model of the amide structure, showing the connection between acid and amine parts.
